original_remote_failure.failure: PostgresStore lacks claim_pending_events called by MemoryService.process_pending

root_cause_review: The PostgreSQL SQL migration already provided an atomic outbox claim primitive, but PostgresStore did not expose the two adapter methods invoked by MemoryService.pending_events/process_pending. Prior direct-SQL primitive tests did not cover the adapter/service path.

fix_review.pending_events: Read-only PENDING/FAILED rows below three attempts, ordered by creation/event ID, materialized as existing Event records; listing does not claim work.
fix_review.claim_pending_events: Delegates to existing claim_memory_outbox(limit,max_attempts) inside the adapter transaction; no duplicate locking/recovery algorithm added.
fix_review.stale_policy: Existing SQL reclaims PROCESSING rows older than five minutes, consumes one attempt for stale recovery, and selects eligible rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
fix_review.transaction_scope: The normal method commits the claim before service projection. When called inside a caller-owned outer transaction, its nested adapter context retains those locks until the outer transaction exits; the new concurrent adapter test deliberately exercises that case.
fix_review.remaining_material_concern: No additional defect found by read-only review of these two adapter methods. Native database behavior remains unverified locally.

new_native_tests.name: test_postgres_service_pending_events_and_failed_processing_stop_at_retry_limit
new_native_tests.coverage: Actual MemoryService.pending_events lists the deferred event and preserves payload/namespace without changing outbox state; actual process_pending records extraction failures exactly three times; exhausted work remains FAILED/attempts3 and cannot be listed, processed or claimed again.

new_native_tests.name: test_postgres_adapter_claims_skip_locked_work_held_by_another_adapter
new_native_tests.coverage: First independent adapter claims two rows while an outer transaction retains locks. A threaded second adapter/connection must claim the other two within five seconds before the first commits. Exact four-event union and disjoint claim sets, PROCESSING state/claim timestamps and zero initial attempts are asserted.

local_verification.ruff_format: passed after formatting only the new test file
local_verification.reason: No DIVE_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN in the local environment; collection/skipping does not validate PostgreSQL execution.

required_followup: Parent must run complete quality-v3 and fresh wheel/install-v3, then verify the exact final published SHA in CI. Native PostgreSQL should execute all prior 23 plus these 2 tests (25 total) with zero failure/skip. Preserve the original 22-pass/1-failure evidence.
limits: This is engineering adapter evidence, not a model-answer trial or a benchmark accuracy increase.
The concurrent test uses two separate adapter instances/connections; sharing a single PostgresStore instance across threads is not asserted.
The service default retry cap is three. The native SQL primitive also supports a caller-specified max_attempts; no new claim is made about scheduler fairness or throughput.

Native PostgreSQL source-forget/consent cases cover retained-Event _process_event reprocessing, not actual process restart or MemoryService.rebuild_projections. Those full-entry tests were executed on SQLite only. No expansion to unpromised PostgreSQL service interfaces is requested.
review_scope: PostgreSQL online ingest/retrieve/delete adapter and newly exposed pending_events/process_pending service path. No whole-service PostgreSQL parity claim.

backend_scope_clarification.sqlite: Independent SQLite cases really close/reopen the service and execute MemoryService.rebuild_projections; those restart/full-rebuild claims apply to SQLite.
backend_scope_clarification.postgres_consent_and_forgetting: Existing native PostgreSQL cases reprocess the original retained Event through _process_event after changing the extractor. They do not execute a process restart or the full MemoryService.rebuild_projections entry point.
backend_scope_clarification.postgres_outbox_addition: New native cases cover MemoryService.pending_events/process_pending, failure cap, and overlapping claims from two adapter instances/connections. They add no general rebuild/restart contract.
unsupported_claims_explicitly_excluded: PostgreSQL full projection rebuild entry-point validation
backend_scope_clarification.prior_review_scope: Any restart/full-rebuild statements in independent-source-grounding reports describe their executed SQLite tests; PostgreSQL was separately reported as locally skipped and native original-event reprocessing only.
